name: integration-radar
description: Watches partner API changelogs, deprecations and sunset schedules, maps each change to the connectors your product uses, and turns relevant changes into planned work.
author: Kevin Goff
highlights: Daily sweep of partner changelogs, deprecation notices and sunset schedules
Maps each change to the connectors and fields your product actually uses
Works with the tracker, wiki and chat tools you already have in Crew

setup.onInstall: cd ui && npm install && npm run build
setup.onUpdate: cd ui && npm install && npm run build
